subject: Science
description: A neuron: dendrites, cell body with nucleus, long axon, axon terminals
alt: A nerve cell (neuron): branching dendrites on the left, a cell body with a nucleus, a long axon and branching axon terminals on the right
prompt: A single neuron laid out horizontally. On the left, a rounded cell body (with a nucleus in the orange accent) with several branching dendrites. A long thin axon runs to the right, wrapped with four to five evenly spaced, identical myelin sheath segments, ending in small branching axon terminals.
checklist: dendrites branch from the cell body; the axon leaves from the opposite side
the cell body contains one nucleus
myelin segments are identical and evenly spaced along the axon
